project_title: Production Machine Learning Search & Retrieval Engine

milestones.name: Dense Semantic Retrieval Baseline
milestones.why_added: Establishes a baseline semantic search pipeline with low architectural complexity.
milestones.tradeoff: High semantic recall, but fails on exact keyword or part-number SKU queries.
milestones.verification_metric: MRR > 0.60 on a 50-query golden dataset with P95 latency <= 100ms.

milestones.name: Sparse BM25 Inverted Index Integration
milestones.why_added: Captures exact lexical matches and specific entity keywords missed by embeddings.
milestones.tradeoff: Requires maintaining dual vector schemas and doubles inverted index storage overhead.
milestones.verification_metric: Exact keyword recall reaches 100% on domain catalog SKUs.

milestones.name: Client-Side Reciprocal Rank Fusion
milestones.why_added: Fuses dense and sparse rank distributions in application memory without score calibration.
milestones.tradeoff: Rank-based heuristic accumulation discards relative score magnitude distances.
milestones.verification_metric: MRR improves by +0.12 over dense search with fusion overhead <= 5ms.

milestones.name: Cross-Encoder Attention Reranking
milestones.why_added: Applies full cross-attention scoring across top 15 candidates to surface top 4 passages.
milestones.tradeoff: Adds 350ms to 450ms CPU compute latency and requires sequence length bounding.

milestones.name: Resilient Production Deployment & Observability
milestones.why_added: Guarantees fault-tolerant serving and latency profiling under variable network loads.
milestones.tradeoff: Introduces operational multi-service management complexity and metric export overhead.
milestones.verification_metric: API achieves 99.9% availability with P95 latency <= 3500ms.
